notes: Covers exactly phase-08 Steps 7-10 as scoped, plus baseline coverage for the new domain/data-layer files (ReportResponse/SkillScoreResponse.fromJson and ReportRepositoryImpl) which had zero prior test coverage. All production code (api_exceptions.dart's NotFoundException, api_client.dart's 404 mapping, report_response.dart, report_repository.dart, report_repository_impl.dart, report_bloc.dart, report_event.dart, report_state.dart, skill_score_row.dart, report_screen.dart) was read and verified against the phase file's Design Constraints before writing tests; no discrepancies were found and no production code was modified. Step 9's edge case (a non-null score alongside sufficientData:false) was verified to render the insufficient-data label and NOT the numeric string, confirming skill_score_row.dart checks `sufficientData` directly rather than `score == null`. Step 10's structural-distinctness requirement was verified via TextStyle.fontWeight/fontStyle assertions on the located Text widgets (bold+non-italic for a valid score vs italic+non-bold for insufficient data), not merely string-content matching. The ReportScreen widget tests use the real ReportBloc (not a MockBloc) driven by a mocked ReportRepository, matching the StatefulWidget-owns-its-own-Bloc lifecycle pattern established by Phase 6's ReadAloudScreen/write_essay_screen_test.dart conventions, since ReportScreen constructs its ReportBloc internally in initState rather than accepting an injected bloc. One overlapping-text-finder issue was caught and fixed during authoring: the fixture's `overall` skill name initially duplicated the literal string 'Overall' used by the section title, producing a `findsOneWidget` failure against two matching Text widgets; the fixture skill name was renamed to 'OverallScore' to disambiguate, with no change to assertions' intent. Full `flutter test` across the whole repo passed: 183 tests total (158 pre-existing + 25 new), 0 failures, 0 skipped. No production code was modified — only new test files: test/unit/features/report/domain/report_response_test.dart, test/unit/features/report/data/repositories/report_repository_impl_test.dart, test/unit/features/report/presentation/bloc/report_bloc_test.dart, test/widget/features/report/skill_score_row_test.dart, test/widget/features/report/report_screen_test.dart.
